name: nanocoder
description: Nanocoder (Nano Collective): an open, local-first coding agent for the terminal that works with any model - Ollama, LM Studio, OpenRouter and other OpenAI-compatible APIs. LOKI runs it for background jobs and saved agents (`nanocoder run`, auto-accept mode: it still stops before shell commands, commits and deletes) and as an agent for make_godot_game. Pick its provider and model with LOKI_NANOCODER_PROVIDER / LOKI_NANOCODER_MODEL (from its agents.config.json).
